mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the water channel was worthwhile because the picture made it clear how a protein can provide a route through the boundary.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final oxygen combination felt somewhat repetitive: the membrane-patch result had already said oxygen could cross its oily middle.

surprise.text: I expected oxygen to help make the boundary, but the compatibility hint paired the fats with water instead. The resulting picture showed the lipid heads facing water on both sides.

arbitrary.text: I didn't initially understand why water had to be combined with the fats before oxygen. The resulting picture helped explain the arrangement, though I followed the compatibility hint to get there.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: building the boundary piece by piece made the different routes easier to picture, though I hope the next chapter offers more to figure out.
